title: 第一卷 第52章 不是所有事都因为你
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

晚饭在院子里进行。

节目组准备了海鲜烧烤。

宋尔尔看见虾和鱿鱼，整个人肉眼可见的精神起来。

主持人都忍不住调侃：“尔尔看到海鲜，状态明显不一样。”

宋尔尔点头。

众人落座时，节目组没有安排固定座位。

许知夏很自然地坐到了陆执旁边。

宋尔尔看见了。

她脚步停了半秒，然后坐到了周闻野和姜眠旁边。

陆执抬眼看她。

宋尔尔低头剥虾，假装没看见。

【她又躲了。】

【许知夏坐陆执旁边了！】

【宋尔尔嘴硬选手。】

【陆执眼神都追过去了。】

晚饭吃到一半，主持人宣布夜间心动谈话规则。

“今晚每位嘉宾可以邀请一位异性嘉宾进行十分钟单独谈话。被邀请者可以接受，也可以拒绝。谈话内容不会全程直播，只会播出部分片段。”

宋尔尔低声：“不会全程直播，但会全程剪辑。”

周闻野点头：“可怕。”

姜眠小声：“我有点紧张。”

宋尔尔看她：“别怕，你可以拒绝。”

姜眠：“真的可以吗？”

宋尔尔：“规则写了可以拒绝，不用觉得不好意思。”

周闻野看向姜眠，认真说：“你拒绝也没事。”

姜眠抿唇笑了：“好。”

另一边，许知夏已经看向陆执。

“陆执，今晚我可以邀请你吗？”

她问得大方。

全场都听见了。

陆执还没回答，镜头已经推近。

宋尔尔低头剥虾。

一只虾被她剥得非常完整。

完整得像在做手术。

陆执看了她一眼。

然后回答许知夏：“可以。”

宋尔尔手指一顿。

虾尾断了。

周闻野看见，小声说：“失误了。”

宋尔尔：“这叫意外损耗。”

姜眠低头憋笑。

弹幕炸开。

【陆执答应了！】

【宋尔尔虾尾断了哈哈哈哈。】

【完了，醋味上来了。】

【但许知夏先开口，陆执拒绝也不礼貌吧。】

宋尔尔把剥好的虾放进自己碗里，咬了一口。

味道挺好。

就是突然没刚才那么香了。

主持人继续问：“尔尔今晚想邀请谁？”

宋尔尔抬头。

所有人都看她。

陆执也看她。

她慢慢擦了擦手，露出一个很营业的笑。

“我邀请顾南舟。”

满桌安静。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Dinner was served in the courtyard.

The program team prepared a seafood barbecue.

When Song Er'er saw the shrimp and squid, his whole body became visibly energetic.

The host couldn't help but joke: "Er'er's condition is obviously different when he sees seafood."

Songer nodded.

When everyone was seated, the program team did not arrange fixed seats.

Xu Zhixia naturally sat next to Lu Zhi.

Songer saw it.

She paused for half a second, then sat next to Zhou Wenye and Jiang Mian.

Lu Zhi looked up at her.

Song Er'er lowered his head to peel the shrimp, pretending not to see it.

[She hid again.】

[Xu Zhixia is sitting next to Lu Zhi!】

[Song Er'er is a tough-talking player.】

[Lu Zhi’s eyes followed him.】

Halfway through dinner, the host announced the rules for the nightly heartbeat talk.

"Tonight, each guest can invite a guest of the opposite sex to have a ten-minute private conversation. The invitee can accept or refuse. The conversation will not be broadcast live in its entirety, only part of it will be broadcast."

Song Er'er whispered: "The whole process will not be broadcast live, but the whole process will be edited."

Zhou Wenye nodded: "Terrible."

Jiang Mian whispered: "I'm a little nervous."

Song Er'er looked at her: "Don't be afraid, you can refuse."

Jiang Mian: "Is it really possible?"

Song Er'er: "The rules are written so you can refuse. Don't feel embarrassed."

Zhou Wenye looked at Jiang Mian and said seriously, "It's okay if you refuse."

Jiang Mian pursed her lips and smiled: "Okay."

On the other side, Xu Zhixia was already looking at Lu Zhi.

"Lu Zhi, can I invite you tonight?"

She asked generously.

The whole place heard it.

Before Lu Zhi could answer, the camera had zoomed in.

Song Er'er lowered his head to peel the shrimp.

One shrimp was completely peeled off by her.

It's as complete as surgery.

Lu Zhi glanced at her.

Then he answered Xu Zhixia: "Okay."

Song Er'er pointed his fingers.

The shrimp tail is broken.

Zhou Wenye saw it and whispered: "Mistake."

Song Er'er: "This is called accidental loss."

Jiang Mian lowered his head and suppressed a smile.

The barrage exploded.

[Lu Zhi agreed!】

[Song Er'er's shrimp tail is broken hahahaha.】

[It’s over, the smell of vinegar is coming.】

[But Xu Zhixia spoke first, so it would be rude for Lu Zhi to refuse.】

Song Er'er put the peeled shrimp into his bowl and took a bite.

It tastes pretty good.

It just suddenly didn't smell as good as before.

The host continued to ask: "Who do you want to invite tonight?"

Song Er'er looked up.

Everyone looked at her.

Lu Zhi also looked at her.

She slowly wiped her hands and showed a very business smile.

"I invite Gu Nanzhou."

The whole table was quiet.
